en: The image shows a historical town square with a large church featuring a tall bell tower at the center. The square is busy with people and market stalls, indicating a lively marketplace. The architecture is typical of Central or Eastern European towns, with multi-story buildings surrounding the square. The postcard has multi-lingual text at the bottom, including Cyrillic, Latin, German, and Hungarian scripts.
